findings.issue: Before a variable the definite article must be 'A(z)' (the file does this everywhere else); a bare 'A' is wrong for titles starting with a vowel sound.

findings.issue: 'Giftable spares' is a named UI section, rendered elsewhere as the capitalised plural 'Ajándékozható tartalékok'. Here it is a lowercase singular, which is inconsistent.
findings.suggested: Ez felfedi a kulcsot — véglegesen eltávolítva az Ajándékozható tartalékok közül —, és beváltja a Steam-fiókodon. Nincs visszavonás.

findings.issue: The definite article is missing before a possessive noun at the start of the sentence ('Kulcsod' should be 'A kulcsod').
findings.suggested: A kulcsod felfedése és beváltása a Steamen — ez csak egy pillanat.

findings.issue: 'Claim' is translated 'igénylés' elsewhere (claimWizardTitle, giftConfirmBody), but here it is 'beváltás', the word the file uses for 'redeem'. That blurs two distinct actions.
The fixed article 'a' before {{total}} breaks for values starting with a vowel sound (e.g. 'az 500 GB'). Attaching a case suffix to the placeholder is also fragile.

'bottle' is left in English here and in steam.install.bottleNameReadonlyHelper, but translated as 'palack' in steam.bottle.statusPollTimeout, steam.install.forceWindowsHelp and steam.install.sharedBottleNotice.

findings.en: This installs through Steam's own client, so there's nothing to choose here. Turn on native Steam installs in Settings to manage install location and Windows compatibility from GameLib.

terminology_notes:
The core terms are used consistently: telepítés (install), könyvtár (library), áruház (store), beváltás (redeem), felfedés (reveal), szinkronizálás (sync), bejelentkezés (sign-in). The informal 'te' register is used throughout, as is conventional for game UI. Systemic issues, noted once here rather than flagged per row: (1) Hungarian orthography requires a hyphen in proper-noun + common-noun compounds ('Steam-könyvtár', 'Steam-kulcs', 'Steam-fiók'). The file mixes 'Steam-könyvtár' and 'Steam-fiókodon' with the unhyphenated 'Steam könyvtár', 'Steam kulcs', 'Steam szerverek', 'Steam letöltés' and 'Steam telepítő' in most rows. This is common in software, but it is inconsistent. (2) 'build' appears as 'buildben', 'build-ben' and 'verzióban' across the 'unavailable on this build' rows. 'Verzió' also collides with the about.version label. (3) 'bottle' appears as both 'bottle' and 'palack' (flagged). (4) 'claim' appears as both 'igénylés' and 'beváltás' (flagged). The brand inflections 'Steamen', 'Steamet' and 'Humble-on' are correct. 'Humble Bundle-be' is correctly hyphenated. All {{placeholders}},
, <3> and the A(z) article convention before variables are preserved correctly. The one exception is a bare 'A {{title}}' (flagged).
overall: This is a solid, fluent machine translation. There are no critical errors: no inverted meanings, no broken placeholders and no mistranslated brands. Most issues are orthographic (suffix hyphenation on brand names, mixed hyphenation of Steam compounds) or terminology inconsistencies. There is one real sense error, in the theme names ('Old School' rendered as 'old pupil'; 'Marine' as 'sailor'). Confidence is high on meaning and placeholder checks. Hyphenation and capitalisation judgments follow standard Hungarian orthography (AkH), but software-UI practice varies, so several minors are arguably style preferences. I did not see the strings in rendered UI, so length and truncation were not assessed.
